text:
Hi Everyone 🤍,
I really need help right now and I don’t know where else to turn.

My girlfriend and I are being forced to leave the hostel we’ve been staying at and working for, effective immediately. We were just transferred to Van Nuys a few days ago with everything we own, and now we’re being told it’s “not a good fit” and that all locations are suddenly full. We weren’t given a real reason, just told to go.

We are literally about to be put out with all of our belongings in our hands and nowhere to go. No plan. No destination. Just… out.

I have been through homelessness before, and I am genuinely terrified of going through that again. It’s not just “finding somewhere to sleep.” It’s losing everything you own piece by piece, carrying your life around, not knowing where you’re safe, and constantly being turned away when you ask for help.

I have spent hours trying to find resources. I’ve gone in person to places that were listed as “available” just to find out they don’t even exist anymore. I called 211 hoping for real help, and all I got were outdated lists sent to my email that led to dead ends. I wasted an entire day chasing help that wasn’t actually there. It feels impossible and honestly unreal.

At this point, I’m not asking for anything big — I just need something immediate. A safe place for us to land, even temporarily. A couch, a room, anything to keep us from being on the street with everything we own.

We are clean, respectful, and actively trying to get back on our feet. We just need a chance to not fall all the way down right now.

If anyone can help, knows someone, or has any real leads, please message me. I am truly scared and running out of time.

Even if you can’t help directly, please consider sharing this. I’m trying to reach as many people as possible before we’re out with nowhere to go. It would mean more than you know🫶🏼

Thank you for reading 🤍
